title: feat: ActionBar component, useActionEngine hook, and Console integration
body:
Action metadata exists end-to-end (schema → engine → runner → individual renderers) but there's no composite component to bridge `ActionSchema[]` → location-filtered toolbar UI, and the Console views don't consume it. This adds the missing bridge layer and wires it into the Console.

### `action:bar` component
- Accepts `ActionSchema[]` + `location` filter, renders each action via its `component` type through ComponentRegistry
- Overflow: actions beyond `maxVisible` (default 3) collapse into `action:menu` dropdown
- Supports all 6 `ActionLocation` values, horizontal/vertical layout, variant/size defaults
- Registered with Designer inputs/defaultProps for Studio integration

### `useActionEngine` hook
- React wrapper around `ActionEngine` — memoized instance with stable callbacks
- Exposes `getActionsForLocation()`, `getBulkActions()`, `executeAction()`, `handleShortcut()`

### Console integration
- **ObjectView (list_toolbar)**: Replaced manual `<Button>` rendering with `SchemaRenderer` + `action:bar`, which now correctly filters by `locations` array (plural) instead of the incorrect `location` (singular) field — fixing a bug where toolbar actions never matched
- **RecordDetailView (record_header)**: Passes `record_header` actions from objectDef to DetailView's header via `action:bar` schema, making record-level actions (e.g., Change Status, Assign User) visible in the detail view for the first time

### Usage

```tsx
<SchemaRenderer schema={{
  type: 'action:bar',
  location: 'record_header',
  maxVisible: 2,
  actions: [
    { name: 'mark_complete', label: 'Mark Complete', type: 'script', icon: 'check', component: 'action:button' },
    { name: 'start_task', label: 'Start Task', type: 'script', icon: 'play' },
    { name: 'delete', label: 'Delete', type: 'api', variant: 'destructive', locations: ['record_more'] },
  ],
}} />
```

```tsx
const { getActionsForLocation, executeAction } = useActionEngine({
  actions: schema.actions,
  context: { record, user },
});
const toolbarActions = getActionsForLocation('list_toolbar');
```

### Tests
23 new tests (12 ActionBar, 11 useActionEngine) — 2,724 existing tests unaffected.

> 
> ----
> 
> *This section details on the original issue you should resolve*
> 
> <issue_title>完善Action Bar渲染及useAction集成：让业务Action按钮真正出现在控制台/Studio界面</issue_title>
> <issue_description># 背景
> 
> 完成了Action协议(schema/handler/注册链路)和示例元数据的全量修正与自动校验（见 objectstack-ai/spec#833, objectstack-ai/spec#836）。但现实Studio和App界面未能根据action.locations渲染业务按钮，终端用户"看得见、点得了"的业务动作（如Mark Complete、Start Task、Mass Complete等）在控制台/前端完全不可用。
> 
> 当前Action体系已彻底规范，注册、校验与handler生命周期完整，但从元数据 → UI控件的"桥接层"缺失，包括但不限于：
> 
> - 按钮未按locations分布渲染到list_toolbar/record_header/list_item等页面区域
> - 没有Action执行引擎(useAction hook)，导致按钮无法触发业务逻辑/handler
> - 缺少参数收集/确认框/成功失败反馈toast等展现细节
> - visible/disabled等条件未动态求值
> - Studio只能浏览Action的元数据，缺乏低代码/配置化的拖放/可见性调试入口
> 
> ---
> 
> ## 具体待修改内容清单
> 
> **1. 实现 UI "ActionBar"/"ActionButton" 组件：**
> - [ ] 根据当前record/list上下文与Action.locations渲染对应按钮/菜单项/批量操作项
> - [ ] 支持所有定义的locations：list_toolbar, list_item, record_header, record_more, record_related, global_nav等
> - [ ] 按照Action.component、icon、label渲染不同样式的按钮（primary/ghost/icon/menu/group等）
> 
> **2. useAction() hook — Action Engine 实现**
> - [ ] 实现完整Action执行协议（见 content/prompts/platform/engine.prompt.md 设计）
>   - pre-check(visible/disabled表达式求值+权限校验)
>   - 确认(confirmText)、参数params收集(弹窗或底栏表单)
>   - 调用handler；catch异常并toast提醒
>   - 成功后触发refresh/导航/其他回调
> - [ ] 支持flow、modal、url等类型的Action分发和弹窗流程
> 
> **3. 条件表达式和权限求值**
> - [ ] 动态运行Action.visible/disabled表达式，根据当前record/user/context实时判定是否显示/置灰按钮
> 
> **4. Studio支持：**
> - [ ] Developer模式下集成Action可视化预览、debug、拖放配置入口（以便开发或低代码端用户制作流程/页面时能看到Action按钮效果）
> - [ ] 支持以热加载/切换view模式等方式展现action bar变化和参数收集过程
> - [ ] 支持业务元数据和插件contribution的actions一致渲染，确保最终页面和Studio预览无割裂
> 
> **5. 完善文档/演示**
> - [ ] 在docs/示例仓库补充"如何让Action出现在UI"的方法、配置参考和集成最佳实践
> - [ ] 补充分层动效、交互流程图、功能预期和兼容性说明
> 
> **6. 自动化测试**
> - [ ] 用jest/playwright等为Action Bar渲染与useAction用例补全端到端覆盖，防止回归
> 
> ---
> 
> ## 后续路径建议
> 
> - 优先实现一条能跑通的"Mark Complete"按钮在任务列表和详情页头部可见+可点+业务逻辑可达的主线
> - 用mock record/user/context数据做可交互验收
> - 再批量推广到其它Action和位置，补足全部类型case
> 
> ---
> 
> 本Issue为"Action从协议驱动到业务控制台落地"的最后关键任务，将极大提升平台低代码体验和实用度。
